A LITTLE CIRCLE TO MAKE YOUR OWN

Easy Sun and Moon Mandala Coloring Page

A smiling sun and crescent moon share the center of this sky-themed mandala. Large stars and circular spaces surround them, ready for a bright or dreamy palette.

  • Large spaces for kids

Inside this little mandala

The sun has broad flame-like rays and sits beside a large crescent moon. A few stars fill the space around the pair. More stars and circles repeat along the outer ring, separated by clear straight lines.

A coloring idea to try

Use warm colors for the sun and cool colors for the moon. Try alternating the outside sections between a daytime blue and a nighttime purple.

Make a little moment of it

Invite your child to choose a color for each kind of shape before starting. White spaces can stay white; finishing every section is optional.

Use pencils or crayons for the smaller sections. Print on paper suited to your materials, and put a protective sheet underneath if using markers. Downloads are free for home and classroom use; please link to this page when sharing the design online.
